The tarball came from `npm pack mermaid@11.17.2 --ignore-scripts` in an empty
folder outside the repository, and its sha512 matched the registry integrity
above before extraction. No package scripts were run, and the package is not a
dependency of anything in this repository.

Every docs page loads this file as a plain script. Material renders diagrams
only on DOMContentLoaded, after this script has set window.mermaid, so
Material never fetches Mermaid from a CDN.

Re-verify:
  npm pack mermaid@11.17.2 --ignore-scripts
  openssl dgst -sha512 -binary mermaid-11.17.2.tgz | openssl base64 -A   # must equal the integrity above (after "sha512-")
  tar -xzf mermaid-11.17.2.tgz package/dist/mermaid.min.js
  shasum -a 256 package/dist/mermaid.min.js                              # must equal the sha256 above
